settings.headline: Why Typical Serums Fail
settings.text: Most hair serums just coat your hair in silicones to make it look shiny temporarily. Our formula works directly at the follicle level. By combining 3% Redensyl and 5% Capixyl, we extend the anagen (growth) phase of your hair cycle, combating hair thinning at its source.

items.question: How long until I see results?
items.answer: Hair grows roughly half an inch per month. You'll notice less shedding within 3-4 weeks. Visible baby hairs and increased density typically appear between 90 to 120 days of consistent, daily use.

items.question: Will it make my hair greasy?
items.answer: Not at all. AuraLocks is a pure water-based peptide serum. It absorbs instantly into the scalp without leaving any oily residue, meaning you can apply it right before going to work.

items.question: What happens if I stop using it?
items.answer: Like skincare, hair care is a continuous process. If you stop using the serum, your hair cycle will eventually return to its previous genetic and environmental baseline over 3-6 months.
